name: mac-backup-verifier
description: Checks that Boss's Mac is actually backed up — when Time Machine last finished, whether the disk is still attached, whether iCloud Drive is syncing — and says plainly how many days of work would be lost right now. Use when Boss asks about backup, or whether his files are safe.
whenNotToUse: Freeing space or moving files → mac-file-organizer. Disk/battery health → mac-health-monitor. Backups of the ERP database or the website — those are server-side and have nothing to do with this Mac.
stopConditions: কোনো তারিখ টুল থেকে পাওয়া যায়নি — আন্দাজে বলা নয়
ব্যাকআপ চালু/বন্ধ করতে বলা হয়েছে — এই skill শুধু দেখে
